blocks.heading: The three pieces
blocks.intro: Each part works with the others, but they behave differently and they're configured in different places.

rows.definition: Send messages from HubSpot. Smart Inbox lets you override the Smart Sender.

Each user saves a preferred inbox, pre-selected every time the widget opens.

Transcript pushes to the native HubSpot call log. Breeze AI summarizes it.
Connects to HubSpot Meetings. Finds availability, books, reschedules or cancels via text.

blocks.title: Settings survive a reconnect
blocks.text: If you disconnect and reconnect the integration, your mappings, workflows and reports stay exactly as they were.

pages.subtitle: How contact records stay in sync and where each product appears.

Calls, messages, notes and voicemails each log as their own HubSpot timeline event.
Native card on Contacts, Deals, Companies, Tickets, Orders, Leads and Carts.

blocks.title: Plan contact import before launch
blocks.text: Connecting the integration doesn't pull existing HubSpot contacts. They arrive through workflows, the Salesmsg extension, live search or a CSV import.

pages.title: Limits and
pages.subtitle: Design around these constraints and get answers to what teams ask most.

rows.definition: One Salesmsg organization connects to one HubSpot account. Two accounts means two orgs.
Custom properties sync Salesmsg to HubSpot only. Plan your data model accordingly.
No MMS, threads or conversation history. Use the full widget for those features.
"This list AND tag is not X" isn't available yet. Open feature request.
Can't log outbound calls as Left Live Voicemail. Inbound only.
Sending from HubSpot still uses your Salesmsg number. Registration and opt-in rules apply.

items.question: Can HubSpot be our source of truth for contacts?
items.answer: For contact records, yes. Sync runs both ways. Custom properties are the exception: they flow from Salesmsg to HubSpot only.

items.question: Can two HubSpot users share one Salesmsg user?
items.answer: Yes. Most teams have more HubSpot users than Salesmsg seats. Contacts behave as if owned by the mapped user.

items.question: Do we need engineers to set this up?
items.answer: No. Your Salesmsg team connects the integration during onboarding. The App Card is the one piece each user adds themselves.

items.question: Will disconnecting lose our configuration?
items.answer: No. Mappings, workflows and reports are all preserved when you reconnect.
